The '''Tarchalia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Shiwal sector/Legends|Shiwal sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEGTW" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Tarchalian gazelle]]s.<ref name="WS" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

The system fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> and was situated within the territory of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tarchalia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-7.<ref name="TEA" />

Although the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the system within the [[Luuq sector/Legends|Luuq sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' depicted it as being located in the Shiwal [[Sector/Legends|sector]],<ref name="TEGTW" /> which is more consistent with the system's earlier depiction on a map within ''The Essential Atlas''.<ref name="TEA" />
